technical_practicality.static_http_scraping: The shell, policies, sitemap, and public JavaScript are accessible with static GETs, but listing records are not in the server-rendered HTML.
technical_practicality.public_api: Not established. No API response or endpoint pattern was verified.
technical_practicality.javascript_browser_dependency: JavaScript is required by the normal UI, but the captured renderer suggests data may be fetched once and then filtered/paged locally. Browser automation was neither used nor needed for this limited code inspection.
technical_practicality.identifier_stability: An internal id is the best candidate; urlid and url_page are useful fallbacks, all still unverified on real records.
technical_practicality.image_practicality: Simple same-domain paths appear possible, but variants, stability, and hotlinking were not tested.
technical_practicality.policy_terms_concerns: No explicit automated-access ban was found, but accuracy, third-party rights, authorized use, and Curaçao-law questions remain.

limitations: The strict eight-request limit was reached.
Two successful JavaScript responses were counted but not saved because the initial collector rejected text/javascript before reading the body; they were not retried.
The DataManager transport implementation was therefore not captured.
No listing/API payload, map marker payload, or live record was collected.
No CHH property detail page was found, and no third-party realtor page was requested.
No browser rendering or automation was used.
No claims are made about authorization, copyright, database rights, or legal permissibility.
recommended_next_step: Do not build a scraper yet. After policy review, run one separately approved, tightly bounded static-HTTP experiment that fetches only the public DataManager script and, if it exposes one, a single small listing-data endpoint response to verify transport, fields, IDs, and completeness.
